snippet.title: Among Us 3D | Release Date Trailer ‍🚀
snippet.description:
Among Us VR is evolving! The game is now officially Among Us 3D. Same game, new name.

The PC version of Among Us 3D will be launching on Steam on May 6, 2025.

Among Us 3D: VR is already available; it launched on November 10, 2022, on the Meta Store and Steam, and on December 5, 2023, for PlayStation VR2 and PICO headsets!

Confused? We've got you. Check out our FAQ here: https://schellgames.com/blog/among-us-3d-faq
